courses.title: Python (Basic to Advanced Masterclass)
courses.description: A master-level structured curriculum designed to guide any learner from basic fundamentals to expert-level mastery of Python using AI-generated visual videos, sub-topic drills, and real-world projects.

levels.levelTitle: Stage 1: Basic Foundations (From Starting to Ending of Basics)
levels.description: Complete zero-to-hero basics of Python. Covering every foundational topic from initial setup, mental models, and terminology to writing your first real project.

modules.title: Starting Point: What is Python & Environment Setup

lessons.title: Absolute Starting Point: What is Python? Core Mental Model
lessons.summary: Understand what Python is, why it matters, and the core intuition behind how it works without confusing jargon.
subTopics: Origin and why it was created
Real-world beginner analogy & mental model
Core terminology every beginner must know
What you can build once you finish this basic stage

lessons.title: Workspace & Tooling: Setting Up Python from Scratch
lessons.summary: Step-by-step setup walkthrough to get your development environment ready, write your first script, and run it.
subTopics: Prerequisites and installation checklist
Configuring your editor and extensions
Running your very first Hello World execution
Verifying installation and fixing common setup errors

modules.title: Building Blocks: Variables, Data Types & Expressions

lessons.title: Memory, Variables & Primitive Data Types in Python
lessons.summary: Learn how variables hold values in memory, different data representations, and how to manipulate values safely.
subTopics: Declaring variables and naming conventions
Numbers, text strings, booleans, and null values
The storage container analogy in memory
Common beginner traps when assigning data

lessons.title: Logic & Decision Making: Conditionals and Branching
lessons.summary: Control how your program behaves based on rules, if-else statements, and boolean truth tables.
subTopics: Comparison operators (equals, greater, lesser)
Combining conditions with AND / OR logic
Writing clean if, else-if, and else decision trees
Avoiding nested conditional spaghetti code

modules.title: Ending the Basics: Loops, Functions & First Mini-Project

lessons.title: Repetition & Automation: Loops, Iteration & Collections
lessons.summary: Harness computational power by repeating tasks automatically without writing duplicate code.
subTopics: The mechanics of counting and repeating
Iterating through lists and collections
Preventing dangerous infinite loops
Practical exercises in repetitive data transformation

lessons.title: Ending the Basics Capstone: Modular Functions & First Real Project
lessons.summary: Bring all basic knowledge together to build your first functioning, complete application from start to finish.
subTopics: Packaging logic into clean, reusable functions
Understanding local vs global variable scope
Step-by-step assembly of the Basic mini-project
Congratulations & graduation from the Basic Track

levels.levelTitle: Stage 2: Main Body - Core Architecture & Implementation
levels.description: Transitioning into the main body of Python. Master core implementation patterns, state lifecycles, and component architecture.

lessons.title: Core Architectural Patterns & Structural Conventions
lessons.summary: Master the main structural patterns used by professional engineers to build scalable codebases.
subTopics: Monolithic vs modular code organization
Encapsulating logic into isolated services
Dependency management and clean imports
Design patterns: Factory, Singleton, and Observer

lessons.title: Asynchronous Pipelines & External Service Integrations
lessons.summary: Handle asynchronous data fetching, web APIs, event listeners, and background processing.
subTopics: Understanding the asynchronous event loop
Making robust API requests with timeout fallbacks
Graceful error handling and retry mechanisms
Real-time streaming and websocket basics

levels.levelTitle: Stage 3: Main Body - Full System Integration & State Management
levels.description: The heart of Python. Connect frontend interfaces, backend datastores, and complex synchronized state pipelines.

modules.title: Advanced State Lifecycles & Relational Data Engineering

lessons.title: Global State Management & Unidirectional Data Flow
lessons.summary: Build predictable, debuggable state architectures that eliminate race conditions across your system.
subTopics: The dangers of two-way state drift
Designing predictable state reducers and stores
Optimistic UI updates with rollback protection
Profiling state re-renders and memory footprints

levels.levelTitle: Stage 4: Master Level - High Scale, Internals & Zero-Trust Security
levels.description: Enter the elite Master tier. Dive under the hood into compiler and runtime internals, micro-optimizations, and enterprise security.

modules.title: Engine Internals, Memory Profiling & High Concurrency

lessons.title: Under the Hood: Engine Internals & Micro-Benchmark Optimization
lessons.summary: Uncover the low-level virtual machine, memory allocation, and profiling techniques to achieve 10x throughput.
subTopics: How the underlying runtime compiles and executes your code
Diagnosing memory leaks with heap snapshots and flame graphs
Lock-free algorithms and parallel worker threads
Benchmarking latency at the 99th percentile (p99)

lessons.title: Zero-Trust Security, Vulnerability Defense & Cryptographic Hardening
lessons.summary: Protect production systems against injection exploits, token hijacking, and unauthorized privilege escalation.
subTopics: Threat modeling and common vulnerability vectors (OWASP)
Cryptographic token generation and tamper-proof signatures
Rate limiting, DDOS mitigation, and IP filtering
Automated security scanning in CI/CD pipelines

levels.levelTitle: Stage 5: Master Level - Production Deployment & Grand Capstone
levels.description: The ultimate capstone. Deploy a portfolio-grade, enterprise-scale production project with global edge caching, CI/CD, and live telemetry.

lessons.title: Architecting the Flagship Master Capstone in Python
lessons.summary: Architect and construct an autonomous, real-world flagship project demonstrating complete mastery from basic to expert.
subTopics: Writing a production System Architecture Document
Multi-tier service decoupling and containerization
Automated testing suites: Unit, Integration & E2E
Deploying to scalable cloud infrastructure with zero downtime

scenes.title: Welcome & Core Objective
